knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Covering with tissue or with the crook of the elbow is the step the guide describes. The other options spread droplets to hands or surfaces.
Tissues with a no-touch bin are listed in the guide. Shared cups and open bins work against the purpose of respiratory hygiene.
The guide spacing rule is about reducing the reach of droplets from a cough. The other options are not infection control reasons.

practicalCriteria: Given a role-play of a coughing visitor, the learner demonstrates cover, bin and clean hands in order without prompts.
Given a waiting area, the learner checks each supply item and reports at least one missing item to the supervisor.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the role-play or workplace check
Stock top-up or fault record for the area
stopWorkCriteria: Supplies are missing in an area with a person who has symptoms: report it at once and do not continue to clean touched surfaces until hands are clean.
